We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the reaction: deprotection of TBS protecting group from an alcohol. The forward reaction: alcohol + TBDMSCl -> TBS-protected alcohol (O-Si bond formed). The reverse (retrosynthesis) is breaking O-Si bond to give free alcohol and TBDMSCl (or TBDMSOTf). The template should correspond to breaking O-Si bond, forming aliphatic hydroxyl functional group, and removing t-butyldimethylsilyl group.

We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional groups broken: "t-butyldimethylsilyl"? maybe "silyl ether". functional groups formed: "aliphatic hydroxyls". bonds broken: O-Si bond. So we can use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.

We need to provide target molecule SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need to specify criteria. Let's list functional_groups_broken: maybe "t-butyldimethylsilyl". functional_groups_formed: "aliphatic hydroxyls". bonds_broken: "O-Si". Let's try.
